sql: SELECT count(f.posting_key) AS listings_above_1_5x_median FROM fct_posting AS f JOIN mart_comp_by_family AS m ON f.family = m.family AND f.seniority = m.seniority WHERE f.is_open AND f.remote_us AND f.is_canonical_listing AND f.comp_mid_usd > (1.5 * m.p50)
